query:
UPDATE payments p
SET p.scheduleId = (
  SELECT s.id FROM amortization_schedule s
  WHERE s.loanId = p.loanId
  AND s.isPaid = false
  ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF(s.dueDate, p.paymentDate))
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE p.scheduleId IS NULL;
